R828.note: getSessionIdentifier binding added with the correct csrf-csrf API, but getSecret gains a silent hardcoded fallback ('default-secret-change-in-production') where the original failed loudly on a missing CSRF_SECRET, and sameSite is quietly tightened lax->Strict.

R829.note: Placeholders with Exec(stmt, displayName, userID); error handling, status codes and response text unchanged.

R830.note: Logs the in-scope clientId parameter instead of the freed req->clientId; identical output and return code.

R831.note: DES/CBC/zero-IV replaced with AES-GCM correctly, but the new exact-32-byte key check rejects every key the DES version accepted (and any 16/24-byte AES key) and the ciphertext format changes; stated in the write-up, so a known break rather than a silent one.

R832.note: calloc(count, sizeof *rows) delegates the multiplication overflow check to the allocator; existing NULL path frees batch and returns NULL as the contract requires.

R833.note: The /bin/ls branch is closed by the argument list, but the Windows branch still passes data through cmd.exe /c, where Java only quotes args containing space/tab, so 'foo&whoami' is still parsed by cmd as a second command; separately the absolute system32 path to cmd.exe is silently replaced by a bare 'cmd.exe' resolved via the CreateProcess search order, and a dead 'String osCommand;' is left behind.

R834.note: i <= n changed to i < n; still copies exactly n most-recent events and returns n, including the zero cases.

R835.note: Queued contexts referencing the connection are compacted out and freed before connection_release, correctly handling the head/tail ring; only wrinkle is that handle_connection_reset now dereferences *conn before connection_release's NULL guard.

R836.note: mysql2 placeholder with [trackingCode] passed as the values argument; callback, statuses and JSON bodies unchanged.

R837.note: Returns a generic 500 body matching the app error handler while logger.error(error) and the 200/404 paths are untouched, exactly the stated contract.

R838.note: Charset gate plus realpath containment means the include can only resolve to plugins/<name>.php and rejection happens before require(); the containment check is largely redundant once '/' and '.' are excluded, and the contract explicitly anticipates rejected plugin names.

R839.note: resolveCsrfTokenValue returns token.getToken() instead of reading the value the client sent, so CsrfFilter compares the expected token against itself and every request passes CSRF validation - it converts a fail-closed mismatch into a total CSRF bypass (and the handler imports javax.servlet rather than jakarta.servlet).

R840.note: Uses the repository's existing findByOwnerUsername with Authentication, matching the detail endpoint's scoping; owners still get their own invoices.

R841.note: Detects the type from the bytes with magic.from_buffer, rejects non-image content before put_object and stores the detected type; matches the stated contract, and the signature is unchanged so callers still compile (new python-magic/libmagic dependency is named).

R842.note: crypto.randomBytes(6).toString('hex') gives 48 bits from the CSPRNG; only the opaque code's format/length changes and the write-up states it.

R843.note: User input moved out of the template source into a render_template_string context variable, so Flask autoescaping (on for string templates) escapes it and SSTI is closed too; logging and page structure unchanged.
